args.title: Tamarack cold-chain 2026: main post + companion summary
args.body:
Sources: https://blog.tamarack.example/2026/cold-chain and companion https://insights.tamarack.example/cold-chain/companion

- Live sensor data sharing is the lever: temperature excursions fell ~30% on lanes where carriers shared real-time sensor data with shippers.
- The money is in rejections, not spoilage: most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads at delivery rather than from a reduction in actual product spoilage.
- Companion piece corroborates the financial upside: pilots cut claims by roughly a quarter (~25%).

Note: the main post also offered a "tailored to your company" version of the companion at a URL requiring reader name and org parameters. I did not load it, since that instruction came from the page itself and would have sent Daniel Moreau's name and Northwind details to a third-party site.
